create_dictionary_class: create a Dictionary class to map tokens to integer indices with bidirectional lookup and unicode normalization
add_tokens_to_dictionary: add new tokens to a Dictionary instance with automatic index assignment and NFD normalization
get_dictionary_tokens: get all non-special tokens from a Dictionary excluding NULL and UNK sentinel entries
create_reader_dataset: create a ReaderDataset PyTorch Dataset for SQuAD-like QA data that vectorizes examples on access
create_sorted_batch_sampler: create a SortedBatchSampler that batches examples sorted by document and question length for efficient padding
